title: Compliance reporting for small waste carriers
thesis: A reporting rule takes effect next year and small carriers have no tooling for it.
note: Timing evidence dominates; demand is implied by a deadline rather than observed.

evidence.title: Regulator publishes the reporting requirement
evidence.body: From next April, carriers below the current threshold must file quarterly movement records.

evidence.title: Carrier describes the current process
evidence.body: We keep paper tickets in a box. If we have to file quarterly we will need something.

evidence.title: Trade press notes the absence of tooling
evidence.body: Existing compliance suites target large operators and start well above what a two-lorry firm would pay.
